description: This file declares the PidFd class, which provides interfaces for managing process file descriptors, launching subprocesses, retrieving process information, and halting process hierarchies within the 'cuttlefish::process_sandboxer' namespace.
external_methods: absl::StatusOr<PidFd> PidFd::LaunchSubprocess(absl::Span<const std::string>, std::vector<std::pair<sapi::file_util::fileops::FDCloser, int>>, absl::Span<const std::string>)

classes.name: PidFd
classes.description: A class for managing process file descriptors, including launching processes, retrieving information, and halting processes and their descendants.

methods.name: FromRunningProcess
methods.description: Returns a managed pidfd for a process given its pid, with a note on reliability if the process has been reaped.

methods.name: LaunchSubprocess
methods.description: Launches a subprocess with specified arguments, file descriptors, and environment, returning a pidfd for the new process.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns the process ID associated with this pidfd.

methods.name: AllFds
methods.description: Copies the file descriptors from the target process into the current process.

methods.name: Argv
methods.description: Retrieves the argument vector of the process.

methods.name: Env
methods.description: Retrieves the environment variables of the process.

methods.name: HaltHierarchy
methods.description: Terminates the process and all its descendant processes.

methods.name: HaltChildHierarchy
methods.description: Terminates all child processes of the process, only safe if no new children are spawned or reaped during execution.

calls: absl::StatusOr<PidFd> PidFd::LaunchSubprocess(absl::Span<const std::string>, std::vector<std::pair<sapi::file_util::fileops::FDCloser, int>>, absl::Span<const std::string>)
